subtitle: Catching a real mistake before it reaches the dashboard

eyebrow: Generic tests, mapped to real risk
code:
models:
  - name: stg_billing_events
    columns:
      - name: subscriber_id
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: event_type
        tests:
          - accepted_values:
              values: ['signup','upgrade','cancel']
  - name: dim_subscribers
    columns:
      - name: subscriber_id
        tests: [unique, not_null]
caption: unique on dim_subscribers catches the most damaging failure for a dimension table: duplicate rows.

eyebrow: A singular test for a real business rule
code:
-- assert_no_cancellation_before_signup.sql
-- Fails if this query returns ANY rows
select subscriber_id, first_seen_at, cancelled_at
from {{ ref('dim_subscribers') }}
where cancelled_at is not null
  and cancelled_at < first_seen_at
caption: No generic test could express this -- a cancellation can never happen before a signup.
